name: A Man Who Defies the World of BL
description: Mob tries to avoid being the main character in a BL world, but as love finds him, he must choose between staying in the background or embracing romance.

videos.title: vs. Meeting
videos.overview: The protagonist discovers that he lives in a world where BL romances happen and learns that his brother, Ayato, received a love confession from his best friend. On his way to university, the protagonist avoids interacting with others, causing Kuroda and Yūki to bump into each other and fall in love. During lunch, his friends Ryōta and Tōma fall in love.

videos.title: vs. Drinking Party
videos.overview: The protagonist is invited to a drinking party by his classmate, Sakita, who also invites lone wolf Kaji, broken-hearted Akihito, and Takimoto. By the end of the evening, Sakita and Kaji fall in love while Akihito and Takimoto become a couple.

videos.title: vs. My Brother's Friend
videos.overview: Ayato invites his friends over, including Tōjō, the person who confessed to him. The protagonist discovers that Ayato and his friends have a complicated love square relationship.

videos.title: vs. Group Blind Date
videos.overview: The protagonist is invited to a group blind date by his classmate, Misaka. Uchiumi steals the girls' attention but expresses interest in the protagonist, causing the protagonist avoid him and have him pair up with Misaka instead. After the two men leave, the group date becomes a failure as the girls have lost interest.

videos.title: vs. Yaoi Fanboy
videos.overview: The protagonist meets Mayama, who is secretly a BL manga artist, but avoids him. Mayama, who is a fan of male relationships, decides to watch over the relationships of other men, observing Hikaru and Shun falling in love and wishing that he lives in a world where BL romances are common.

videos.title: vs. My Brother's Friend Part 2
videos.overview: Ayato realizes Tōjō is serious about him and starts to realize his own feelings for him when they become distant. The two make up and begin dating.

videos.title: vs. Flag
videos.overview: The protagonist finds chocolate for Valentine's Day in his bag and later realizes they are from his classmate, Kikuchi. To avoid him, the protagonist has him sit with Miyoshi, only to have Miyoshi's boyfriend, Haruo, interrupt class.

videos.title: vs. Flag Overtime
videos.overview: The protagonist gets drunk and falls unconscious, but he learns that Kikuchi had carried him home. Kikuchi confesses to the protagonist that he has been in love ever since the protagonist spoke to him when he was feeling upset. Despite conscious efforts to avoid Kikuchi, the protagonist eventually gives into his feelings for him.

videos.title: vs. Contact
videos.overview: Mob’s new workout routine backfires when unavoidable contact sparks the ultimate romance flag.

videos.title: vs. Halloween
videos.overview: At a Halloween party, Mob faces sweet danger when an adorable Little Red Riding Hood appears.

videos.title: vs. Scent
videos.overview: Mob’s sharp nose detects the “scent of love” in class, but a matching shampoo sparks confusion.

videos.title: vs. Age-Gap
videos.overview: On his way home, Mob encounters a crying middle schooler—and the next romance flag appears.

videos.title: vs. Confession
videos.overview: An unfamiliar boy confesses to Mob, insisting they share a forgotten memory from long ago.

videos.title: vs. Cupid
videos.overview: To dodge Hatano’s love flag, Mob plays matchmaker—but fate refuses to follow his script.

videos.title: vs. Compliance
videos.overview: Hatano vows to confess again in three years, leaving Mob stunned by his pure determination.

videos.title: vs. School Festival
videos.overview: Mob visits a school play to film his brother but finds himself caught in another love setup.

videos.title: vs. Beginnings of Love
videos.overview: Mob wonders how love starts, but a simple question to his brother opens new romantic flags.

videos.title: vs. Helper
videos.overview: Asked to be a filming extra, Mob’s low profile crumbles as a new BL story begins without warning.

videos.title: vs. Filming
videos.overview: An accident thrusts Mob and Hatano into lead roles, blurring the line between acting and feeling.

videos.title: vs. Falling in Love
videos.overview: After filming ends, Kikuchi’s return threatens to turn Mob’s quiet life into a love triangle storm.

videos.title: vs. Pollen Allergy
videos.overview: Mob battles springtime chaos—and his own allergy—while dodging every possible “BL flag” of love.

videos.title: vs. Pretending
videos.overview: Mob’s attempt to dodge a fake boyfriend request backfires, sparking an unexpectedly wild love act.

videos.title: vs. Falling Asleep
videos.overview: A sleepy mix-up at home and a soothing professor’s voice push Mob into dangerously “BL” territory.

videos.title: vs. Study Session
videos.overview: A late-night study session turns suspiciously romantic when Mob ends up alone with top student Saionji.

videos.title: vs. Contradictions
videos.overview: Mob’s mix-up with Matsuya’s umbrella triggers a wave of BL-style contradictions he can’t escape at all now.

videos.title: vs. Work Experience
videos.overview: At a kindergarten work placement, Ayato draws jealous stares while Mob stumbles into new BL flags of his own.

videos.title: vs. Fights
videos.overview: Mob tries to dodge a BL flag when Kōji picks a fight, only for the heroic Seigi to appear and turn chaos into destiny.

videos.title: vs. Matching
videos.overview: A matchmaking mishap puts Mob on alert, but overeating soggy fries leads him to trigger an even bigger BL flag.

videos.title: vs. Christmas
videos.overview: Mob dodges every Christmas BL flag with a perfect plan, only to run into Hatano while Kikuchi secretly watches.

videos.title: vs. Falling Asleep, Returns
videos.overview: Mob’s nap sparks a massive BL flag when Hatano catches him sleeping, forcing him to choose an unexpected escape.

videos.title: vs. Unlucky
videos.overview: Mob shelters an extremely unlucky classmate, only to invite a disaster even scarier than a BL flag into his home.

videos.title: vs. Valentine’s Day
videos.overview: On Valentine’s Day, Mob dodges BL fate by running a cake errand—while desperately avoiding the boy who likes him.
